name: Band Side Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall holding a resistance band in front of your chest with your elbows raised out at shoulder height and bent near 90 degrees.
Brace your core and keep your upper arms parallel to the floor.
Extend both elbows simultaneously to pull the band smoothly out to your sides until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows slowly back toward your chest while keeping steady tension in the band.
tips: Keep your upper arms level at shoulder height rather than letting your elbows drop.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears instead of shrugging as you press out.
